messages.subject: grobWidth of legend and position of legend
parts:
Hi dear all,

If p is a ggplot2 object,

p <- qplot(data = mtcars, x = mpg, y = wt, facets = cyl ~ ., color =
cyl)

is there anyway to get the grobWidth of legend and legend position in
ggplot2 0.9? basically, I want to get the width of the legend and
it's position, then when doing the alignments of multiple plots, I
could consider this to make relevant adjustment.

Thanks

Tengfei

> ggplot2 0.9?  basically, I want to get the width of the legend and

ggplot_gtable(ggplot_build(p))

and then look at the gtable package on my github. This probably won't
be fully implemented until 0.9.1, but any comments you have will be
greatly appreciated.
